literal_meaning: ছল (trick or pretext) ধরা (to catch or grasp)
figurative_meaning_bn: কথার খুঁত বা দোষ বার করা
figurative_meaning_en: To find faults or flaws in someone's words or speech
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই যুক্তিতে সহজেই ছল ধরা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: I caught the flaw in his statement.
It's easy to pick holes in this argument.
